_readme: S423 SkyLaurel, 2026-10-19. Merced's capture-only read (run 39115547722) found eight programs' Requisites pages by label and name but below the coverage gate: Diesel Equipment Technology (03485 A.S., 19495 certificate), Mechanized Agriculture Technology (07710, 19496), Compact Power Equipment (16653), International Studies (17943), Communication Studies (30638) and Agriculture Systems - Agriculture Foundation (44160, noncredit). This read prints each page whole, to see whether it prints course codes the state's file does not list (a renumbered subject), prints none (a list by title), or is the wrong page, before naming a cause. No model call; robots.txt first, one load a page.

outside_hosts.coursedog.com: Merced's catalog vendor: the catalog's own scripts on catalog.mccd.edu call app.coursedog.com for each program's requisites.

questions.codes: Which course codes each Requisites page prints, against the state's listed codes for the program.
